abort_and_rollback.reason: isolated cleanup, abort and verified rollback not demonstrated

active_source_identity.reason: installed source differs or is not authenticated as frozen G10

data_free_8gib_reserve.reason: snapshot free bytes cover static 8 GiB reserve

external_sustained_power.reason: all observed external supply paths offline

gpu_chip_driver_abi.reason: node presence does not identify GPU chip, driver, firmware or tinygrad ABI

hard_quota_and_scratch_peak.reason: no enforced isolated hard quota or measured scratch peak including model cache

independent_live_parked.reason: flags disagree or are incomplete; independent live parked monitor absent

memory_headroom_and_peak.reason: single MemAvailable observation; compiler CPU/GPU peak RSS and abort ceiling unmeasured

non_driving_constraints.reason: physical parked state and exclusion of driving not independently confirmed

staged_source_identity.reason: no isolated staged checkout hash in passive transcript

thermal_and_gpu_error_monitor.reason: untyped point temperatures; no continuous CPU/GPU thermal or GPU error monitor
